verdict.rationale: Crossmint lets users define scoped rules (spend caps, counterparty allow-lists, time windows) that once set let an agent act autonomously without per-action prompts, and states 'Transaction rules enforced onchain' — a form of automatic rule-based action. However this is closer to pre-authorized permission bounds than true event-triggered automation, and the docs explicitly note agent checkouts have 'no webhooks in v1', meaning event-driven triggering isn't supported there. Missing for 10: an explicit rules/automation engine that fires actions on arbitrary external or on-chain events, webhook/event-subscription support, and independent confirmation of automated rule execution beyond spend-limit enforcement.
